scope: Full pinned PBO constructor/setter and MP1 instructions; synthetic PCI lookup/access, globals, locks, delay and family. Neither firmware nor hardware behavior is validated.
observations: Shimada PCI 153a constructor sets flag +11h to one; subsequent Fmax uses 70h.
The other Fmax flag path uses 6Dh; neither setter waits for completion.
Rails input mirrors one zero input, packs two low 9-bit fields and sends 61h then 5Dh.
A8 uses RSMU addresses despite the MP1_C2PMSG function name; failed response still publishes the output word.
Every injected original PCI failure permits later accesses; this is evidence of original behavior, not a recommended protocol.
